message:
## Vulnerability Digest

The primary product scan combined and deduplicated entries from `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` only. `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined. The scan window was **2026-10-04 23:40 UTC through 2026-10-05 23:40 UTC** (**2026-10-05 05:10 IST through 2026-10-06 05:10 IST**).

Seven consolidated findings qualified: six newly announced LibreOffice CVEs and one fresh Docker Desktop information-exposure update. Canonical also issued a new Ubuntu security notice for eight earlier LibreOffice CVEs; it is included because the Ubuntu-specific fix availability is new in this window.

### Findings

**1. LibreOffice Calc remote code execution — CVE-2026-63277**
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 4.0 score 8.5
- **Affected product:** LibreOffice 26.2 before 26.2.5; the vendor lists 26.2.5 and 26.8.0 as fixed.
- **Description:** A crafted Calc document could name a Java database driver at a remote location, causing Java code from that location to run when the document is opened.
- **Relevance:** LibreOffice is explicitly monitored. The listed inventory versions are older than the CNA's confirmed affected range, so applicability to those older builds should be verified rather than assumed.
- **Source:** [The Document Foundation advisory](https://www.libreoffice.org/about-us/security/advisories/cve-2026-63277)

**2. LibreOffice arbitrary file write — CVE-2026-63266**
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS 4.0 score 6.8
- **Affected product:** LibreOffice 26.2 before 26.2.5.
- **Description:** A crafted Calc external-data link could use an embedded Firebird database to write a file anywhere the current user could write.
- **Relevance:** Direct match to monitored LibreOffice; older-version applicability is not established by the CNA record.
- **Source:** [The Document Foundation advisory](https://www.libreoffice.org/about-us/security/advisories/cve-2026-63266)

**3. LibreOffice local-file read and SSRF through CSV links — CVE-2026-63267**
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS 4.0 score 6.7
- **Affected product:** LibreOffice 26.2 before 26.2.5.
- **Description:** Opening a crafted Calc document could read a local file into a sheet or make a request to a host chosen by the document.
- **Relevance:** Direct match to monitored LibreOffice; older-version applicability is not established by the CNA record.
- **Source:** [The Document Foundation advisory](https://www.libreoffice.org/about-us/security/advisories/cve-2026-63267)

**4. LibreOffice local-file read through SQL data links — CVE-2026-63268**
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS 4.0 score 6.7
- **Affected product:** LibreOffice 26.2 before 26.2.5.
- **Description:** A crafted SQL-type Calc data link could point at a local text-file directory and load local file contents into the spreadsheet.
- **Relevance:** Direct match to monitored LibreOffice; older-version applicability is not established by the CNA record.
- **Source:** [The Document Foundation advisory](https://www.libreoffice.org/about-us/security/advisories/cve-2026-63268)

**5. LibreOffice local-file read and SSRF through HLS playlists — CVE-2026-63269**
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS 4.0 score 6.7
- **Affected product:** LibreOffice 26.2 before 26.2.5 on Linux configurations using GStreamer.
- **Description:** A linked HLS playlist in a document could make GStreamer read listed local files and remote URLs, with content potentially ending up in the document.
- **Relevance:** Direct match to monitored LibreOffice, with Linux/GStreamer configuration required; older-version applicability is not established by the CNA record.
- **Source:** [The Document Foundation advisory](https://www.libreoffice.org/about-us/security/advisories/cve-2026-63269)

**6. LibreOffice environment and INI-value disclosure — CVE-2026-63270**
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS 4.0 score 6.7
- **Affected product:** LibreOffice 26.2 before 26.2.5.
- **Description:** Crafted document URLs could expand environment variables or INI-file values and exfiltrate potentially sensitive data to a remote server.
- **Relevance:** Direct match to monitored LibreOffice; older-version applicability is not established by the CNA record.
- **Source:** [The Document Foundation advisory](https://www.libreoffice.org/about-us/security/advisories/cve-2026-63270)

**7. Docker Desktop sensitive values written to logs — no CVE assigned**
- **Severity:** Not stated by Docker.
- **Affected product:** Docker Desktop; Docker documents the fixes in version 4.94.0 but does not state a complete affected-version range.
- **Description:** Docker Desktop 4.94.0 fixes stored API keys appearing in cleartext logs and diagnostic bundles, and stops unobfuscated IPC payload values from being logged.
- **Relevance:** Docker Desktop is explicitly present in the monitored list. The inventory's recorded 4.19.0.0 version cannot be confirmed affected from the release note alone.
- **Source:** [Docker Desktop 4.94.0 release notes](https://docs.docker.com/desktop/release-notes/#4940)

### Newly available Ubuntu fix

**USN-8868-1 — LibreOffice vulnerabilities**
- **Severity:** Not stated as a single rating by Canonical.
- **Affected product:** Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, 24.04 LTS, and 26.04 LTS LibreOffice packages.
- **Issues:** CVE-2026-63272, CVE-2026-63273, CVE-2026-63274, CVE-2026-63275, CVE-2026-63276, CVE-2026-63278, CVE-2026-63279, and CVE-2026-50593. These cover malformed WMF/PDF/CFF/PICT/font inputs that can cause crashes, possible code execution, or information disclosure.
- **Relevance:** Both Ubuntu and LibreOffice are monitored. The CVEs predate the window, but Canonical's Ubuntu-specific security update was published on October 5 and is the fresh development.
- **Source:** [Canonical USN-8868-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8868-1)

### Possible matches needing review

- **Ubuntu 22.04 Raspberry Pi kernel — USN-8871-1:** Canonical published fixes for 21 kernel CVEs, including a local ARM memory-protection bypass/privilege-escalation issue. This applies only if monitored Ubuntu systems use the Raspberry Pi kernel flavor. Severity was not stated as a single rating. [Canonical notice](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8871-1)
- **Ubuntu 18.04 Azure kernel — USN-8851-3:** Canonical published fixes for CVE-2026-53221, CVE-2026-53131, and CVE-2025-38724. This applies only if monitored Ubuntu systems use the Azure 5.4 kernel flavor under Ubuntu Pro. Severity was not stated as a single rating. [Canonical notice](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8851-3)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations and libraries, MongoDB-owned notices, CVE/NVD-oriented records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA-oriented reporting.

No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported or updated within the exact window. The latest entries visible on MongoDB's official alerts page predated this scan window. [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)

### Review priority

Immediate review is recommended for LibreOffice deployments because CVE-2026-63277 is rated High and can lead to code execution when a crafted document is opened. Validate deployed LibreOffice versions before applying the upstream 26.2-series mapping, and review Docker Desktop 4.94.0 where diagnostic bundles or application logs may be accessible to other users or support workflows.
